description: This file defines the IWorkflowManager interface and extension methods related to workflow management in OrchardCore, including creating, starting, triggering, resuming, and executing workflows.

classes.name: IWorkflowManager
classes.description: Interface for managing workflows, including creation, starting, triggering events, resuming, and executing workflows.

classes.name: WorkflowManagerExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IWorkflowManager, such as triggering events and restarting workflows.

methods.name: NewWorkflow
methods.description: Creates a new workflow instance for the specified workflow definition.

methods.name: TriggerEventAsync
methods.description: Triggers a specific event within the workflow system.

methods.name: StartWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Starts a new workflow based on a workflow type and optional start activity.

methods.name: RestartWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Restarts a workflow with given input and workflow type.

methods.name: ResumeWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Resumes a workflow at a specified activity.

methods.name: ExecuteWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Executes a workflow starting at a specified activity.
